## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 340 reads during 360 hours of rostered work. This represents a recorded rate of 0.9 per hour. The workload was reviewed against the available hours and the reported activity, with the current session pattern retained for the period under review.

## Quality

A further 26 reads were checked to assess consistency. The recorded agreement was 57.7 per cent. This result was considered alongside the workload information and the checking completed during the review. No change to the current session pattern was agreed.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
